title: LIST OF VCOAS COMMENDATION CARD AWARDEES
body_text:
List of VCOAS Commendation Card awardees on the occasion of Independence Day 2026 is enclosed. Attached file :- List of pers being Awarded VCOAS Commendation Card Aug 2026.
*********
Nishant/ Rinku Singh

enrichment.summary: The Ministry of Defence released a list of Indian Army personnel awarded the Vice Chief of Army Staff (VCOAS) Commendation Card on the occasion of Independence Day 2026. The announcement consists of an attached file naming the awardees, with no further details provided in the release text.
enrichment.context: The VCOAS Commendation Card is one of several honours awarded periodically to Army personnel for meritorious service, often on occasions like Independence Day and Republic Day, alongside other commendations such as Chief of Army Staff (COAS) Commendation Cards and gallantry/service medals. These awards recognize individual contributions but are administrative and ceremonial in nature, not indicative of policy change or institutional reform.
